task: Welcome to TextWorld! First off, if it's not too much trouble, I need you to go to the north. Then, open the gate. Then, head west. And then, make an effort to head north. With that done, ensure that the hatch in the steam room is open. After that, try to move west. And then, travel west. With that over with, make an effort to go to the west. If you can get through with that, make an effort to move south. After that, attempt to head south. With that accomplished, attempt to travel east. After that, try to travel south. And then, travel south. After that, take a trip east. And then, make an attempt to take a trip north. Then, go north. Okay, and then, attempt to venture north. Next, lift the sandwich from the floor of the bar. That's it!
description:
Well, here we are in a still office. You begin to take stock of what's in the room.



There is an open door leading north. There is an exit to the south. Don't worry, it is unguarded.

thought: I should go north through the open door.
feedback:
Well, here we are in a recreation zone.

You see a portmanteau. You see a bed stand. Why don't you take a picture of it, it'll last longer! The bed stand is typical. But the thing is empty, unfortunately. Aw, here you were, all excited for there to be things on it!

There is a closed gate leading west. There is an open door leading south.
